question: Can exact cross-channel transported Gram geometry plus a target-free width-pooled network context close P2R0F2J's remaining late-layer mean gap and persistent four-network safety failures?

parent_evidence.interpretation: J establishes a real distributed late-layer gain, but its strictly local diagonal coherence cannot discriminate the persistent hard networks. The omitted full transported Gram and width-pooled context are one materially different lawful observability intervention.

data.host_rule: Use the old deterministic host unless max(final_layer_mse,max_layer_mse)>5e-7; all 11 such ranks must use the near-floor-min repair.

architecture.name: full-Gram pooled-context four-channel residual observer
architecture.local_input: J's raw20 plus four each of m/R, m/(sigma*R), log1p(e/R^2), and diagonal coherence, plus six rho values
architecture.network_pool: mean_width(x) concatenated with sqrt(mean_width(x^2)+1e-8), yielding 84 target-free values per layer
architecture.heads: layer-specific four-source and four-gain heads consume concatenated H96 local plus H32 context
architecture.material_difference: Unlike J's pointwise diagonal-energy cell, K exposes all six cross-channel W-squared contribution correlations and a permutation-invariant whole-network context; unlike I it does not learn or carry a variance state.

training.loss: Exactly J/D's fit-fold-normalized corrected-layer rollout plus equal final focus, 2e-5 normalized auxiliary-state penalty, and 5e-4 near-identity transport/mixing penalty; no context, covariance, or hard-row auxiliary loss.
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 6 in every fold; no checkpoint selection.

decision_gate.pass: Every rollout is finite AND OOF final-layer MSE <2.9672528546945005e-8 AND maximum per-network final-layer MSE <1e-7.
decision_gate.fail: Any conjunct fails; close this exact full-Gram pooled-context form measured and do not meter or deploy it.

difficulty_caveat.claim: K must improve the ordinary 684 networks as well as the hard four; the Gram shift is not preregistered as a sufficient selector.

cost_contract.requirement: Preserve this frozen structural estimate; run a literal flopscope meter only after the accuracy gate passes.

launch_gate.condition: Do not start fold training until D4 is terminal or root explicitly releases the heavy lane.

outcome.pass: Promote K for literal deployment construction and separately test raw-accuracy transfer to a cheap host.
outcome.fail: Close P2R0F2K measured; retain the broader autonomous residual problem open.
